response.original_title: Wreck of the Car Ferry Milwaukee
response.overview: In this captivating new program, Southport Video takes you back to the S.S. Milwaukee's final voyage. You will hear the ship's fateful story, and through the use of stunning underwater photography you will get a bow-to-stern tour of the ship in her final resting place, much of her cargo still intact. Numerous rare photgraphs complete the picture. The third in a series of videos about Great Lakes ghost ships, The Wreck Of The Car Ferry Milwaukee is a must for every maritime enthusiast.
